title: Numerical Spectrum Linking: Identification of Governing PDE via Koopman-Chebyshev Approximation with Resampling
summary: A numerical framework is proposed for identifying governing partial differential equations (PDEs) from observational data by establishing a link between observation-driven and equation-driven Koopman operators in a common Chebyshev spectral domain.
